notes.title: Fates of Moira - Update 1.5
notes.content:
Hello Warriors!

[b]Achilles: Legends Untold[/b] just got even more exciting! We're thrilled to introduce the latest update, [b]Fates of Moira[/b], which adds a new layer of challenge and depth to your post-game experience. If you've already conquered the main story, these new gameplay mechanics will keep you engaged for hours with unique trials that test your skills, strategy, and endurance. Designed to extend your adventure, Fate of Moira introduces fresh ways to approach the game and rewards players willing to push their limits.

[previewyoutube=q2ytN7qanH0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/d83954371fd2cf194fb5f3a0a8bed033f5003898.png[/img] The Fates of Moira: What Awaits You? [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/d83954371fd2cf194fb5f3a0a8bed033f5003898.png[/img][/h1]

The Fates are not kind, but they offer an opportunity for the bravest of warriors to redefine their legacy. Each Fate presents a distinct challenge that alters the core mechanics of combat, forcing you to adapt and overcome. Success brings greater rewards, but failure will come swiftly for the unprepared.

[h2]Inevitable Fate of Atropos – The Path of Caution [/h2]

Atropos, the Fate who cuts the thread of life, has placed a dangerous condition on your journey. Every strike you land is fatal to your enemies, but be warned—one misstep, one blow from an enemy, and Achilles will meet his end. In this mode, precision and caution are your greatest allies.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/14816012277df36a254df3263b765d3f91bda7d9.gif[/img]

[i]Mechanically:[/i] Every melee strike instantly kills non-boss enemies. However, any hit Achilles takes will also instantly kill him. Shield usage is crucial, but you cannot throw it or use items from your belt. No Weapon Skills are allowed.

[h2]Fate of Clotho the Spinner – The Path of Aggression [/h2]

Clotho spins the thread of life, but in this trial, time itself is your enemy. Your health drains steadily with each passing second, forcing you to stay on the offensive. The only way to stop the clock is by entering Heroic Vigor, while every enemy you slay through your Drain Souls ability grants a second chance to survive. In this Fate, relentless aggression is the key to staying alive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/cc5f56bbbe0a969895205f2aef17a2f552c1e6ed.gif[/img]

[i]Mechanically:[/i] Achilles loses 15 HP per second, but using Hades Vision (HV) temporarily halts the drain. You can use Drain Souls anytime, healing 300 HP per kill. No items from the belt or inventory can be used, and in HV, you can only use Drain Souls to heal.

[h2] Fate of Lachesis The Allotter – The Path of Endurance [/h2]

Lachesis, the Fate who measures the thread of life, has sent forth a relentless pursuer to test your endurance. A powerful Lajstrygon hunts you across every map, immune to direct damage but vulnerable to status effects. This monstrous foe will grow stronger, faster, and more dangerous over time, making every moment a desperate struggle for survival. Outsmart it or be consumed by its wrath.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/5e0367054e8474c5559ffc46d4d029e72dab0ed5.gif[/img]

[i]Mechanically:[/i] A Lajstrygon spawns on every map and constantly hunts the player. It cannot be harmed by weapons or Weapon Skills, though it can be slowed, poisoned, set on fire, or made to bleed. The Lajstrygon grows stronger over time and inflicts friendly damage on other enemies. Its health resets if you reload the session, and the Ariadne’s Thread item can despawn it on the same map where it was spawned.

[h1] What’s New in Update 1.5.0?[/h1]

[b]NEW:[/b] The Fates of Moira – Three unique end-game challenges that will test your strategy, precision, and endurance.

[b]UPDATED:[/b] Graphics Improvements – Enjoy a smoother visual experience, especially on lower quality settings.

[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] The crash caused by Cultist actions with the GAIA system has been fixed.
[*] Damage and status effects applied by traps and petards are now correctly implemented.
[*] Small performance upgrades for a more stable gameplay experience.
[*] Minor text and localization fixes.
[/list]

Ready to face your fate? Download the update now and see how you fare against the new challenges that the Fates of Moira bring!

We are also excited to announce that [b]Achilles: Legends Untold[/b] will be featured at [b]Tokyo Games Show 2024![/b] Visit us at the Galaktus Indie booth - [b]10-W13[/b] to meet the team, try out the latest updates, and dive into the world of Achilles! Don't miss the chance to experience the game firsthand and learn more about what's coming next!

Also we are running a -45% price reduction for the time of the TGS Steam event!

We're excited to announce that "[b]Achilles: Legends Untold" is at the PAX East Expo![/b] Come talk to us and play our game, we'll be waiting for you at Booth #14049! You can find a map at the end of this post.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1314000/Achilles_Legends_Untold/

Secondly, we've released the [b]new major Update[/b] today! The isometric, stamina-based aRPG combat of "Achilles: Legends Untold" just got even more interesting as the Version 1.2 of the game introduced a powerful new feature - [b]Amulets.[/b]

These mystical items are designed to deepen your gameplay experience, offering a variety of enhancements to aid you on your epic quest through Ancient Greece. We believe they will add [b]a new layer of strategy and customization[/b] to "Achilles: Legends Untold," allowing you to tailor your hero to your playstyle even further.

To give you a better understanding of this update, we've also released a video explaining amulets the new mechanics.

[previewyoutube=B_nxT_T4NqE;full][/previewyoutube]
Whether you're diving into the game for the first time or returning for another playthrough, there's never been a better time to explore the ancient world we've crafted.

[h2]Amulet Mechanics[/h2]

From the very beginning of your journey, amulets are accessible and can be discovered in treasure chests and dungeons scattered throughout the game's world. Each amulet offers [b]unique buffs[/b] and occasionally [b]trade-offs[/b], allowing for strategic customization based on your combat needs or specific encounters.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/db3f836e8fa2e98df045b1b424d9199bc9ff496c.png[/img]

In the [b]New Game Plus (NG+)[/b] and beyond, amulets [b]evolve[/b], offering enhanced abilities and new possibilities. These upgraded versions can also be found in the game, ensuring that even veterans have fresh treasures to discover.

To accommodate these new items, your equipment will now feature one [b]dedicated slot[/b] for amulets, ensuring they're easily accessible and integral to your adventure.

[h2]The Amulets[/h2]

The update introduces [b]7 amulets[/b], each with [b]three versions[/b] to unlock as you progress through NG+ and NG++. Here's a sneak peek into their capabilities:
[list]
[*][b]Do you find yourself running low on HP more often than you'd like?[/b]
Use the Amulet, which increases your vitality stat at the cost of dealing a bit less damage. This difference increases on the 2nd and 3rd item level. Take a hit after hit and still stay strong on the battlefield!
[*][b]Perhaps you're more of a risk taker?[/b]
Equip the Amulet, which increases damage dealt by 25%, but also decreases your defense by 25%. On the 2nd and 3rd item level, you can deal even more damage, but your vulnerabilty will increase just as much. Become a true glass cannon of a warrior!
[*][b]Want those strong attacks to be even heavier?[/b]
We've got you covered! Just use the Amulet, which increases your strong attack damage at the expense of its speed. By the 2nd and 3rd item levels these get even slower, but significantly stronger. You might move like a Cyclops, but you'll hit hard like a Titan!
[/list]
These are just 3 of the 7 amulets you can find in this update. Can you find them all? Share your amulet builds under this post or in the Community Hub and let's see what creative ways to play you'll come up with!

Remember to pay us a visit if you're at PAX East this week and if you don't know how to get there, we've included a map of the Expo Hall below:

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/99b4f3bf7e0a5445c529406091ad79ab1ed2fa79.gif[/img]

[h3]Welcome, warriors![/h3]

[b]The day we've all been waiting for has arrived! We are thrilled to announce that Achilles: Legends Untold has officially launched in its full glory, marking the end of our Early Access period. [/b]It's time to dive into the epic world of myths, monsters, and unforgettable adventures!

[previewyoutube=5wPHr73kims;full][/previewyoutube]

Before we dive into the updated content, we want to extend our heartfelt thanks to each and every one of you who took part in the Early Access phase. Your passion for Achilles: Legends Untold has inspired us to work tirelessly to improve the game, adding new features, enhancing gameplay, and addressing your suggestions and concerns.

Your dedication, feedback, and enthusiasm have been instrumental in making Achilles: Legends Untold what it is today. We've seen countless heroes conquer dungeons, unveil secrets, and battle formidable foes, all thanks to your unwavering support. It has been the driving force behind our journey, and we are incredibly grateful for your trust in our vision.

As we move forward, we are brimming with excitement about the future of Achilles: Legends Untold and our studio. The future holds boundless possibilities, and we can't wait to unveil them with you. For now, we wish you a great time while exploring what the full game has to offer.

[h2]FULL RELEASE CONTENT[/h2]

What exactly can you expect in the 1.0 version?

First off, the story is now complete and ready to discover. There's an entire new open world map available to explore, together with new quests, cutscenes and enemies. Cut through your enemies, find out the truth about your fate and save your homeland from an impending threat!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/70ebf5505aad23bf2d31b90afb17e1d013e5bd98.png[/img]

Secondly, we've introduced side quests to the game. You can finish them whenever you want to, giving you more space to level your character and things to do in between the main storyline tasks.

Another big feature - the revamped Co-op Mode is here! Here's a quick rundown:
[list]
[*] Play solo, team up with a friend, or even join random games.
[*] Your character's progress in the story affects your co-op character, and vice versa!
[*] Embark on exciting arenas that unlock as you progress through the main storyline.
[*] Each arena offers unique items and Weapon Skills available in the co-op store, obtainable with in-game currency.
[*] Complete additional tasks on every map that allow you to earn extra rewards!
[/list]

The 1.0 version also includes new bosses, enemies, items, weapons and locations. There is a lot new content to discover, so don't keep your enemies waiting!

[h2]LIST OF CHANGES:[/h2]

[h3]NEW:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Full Campaign is now available together with new cutscenes
[*] Introduced Side quests!
[*] Added a new huge open world map ("Greece Coastline") and many minor ones
[*] Introduced a new co-op challenge mode (For now just on PC)
[*] Added Many new bosses and enemies.
[*] Added Many new items, weapons, shields.
[*] All of the achievements are now possible to unlock.
[*] Added interactable cats - find and pet them all!
[*] Introduced the ability to reset Skill Points at the cost of Drachmas - look for it in the SkillTree.
[*] Introduced option to change difficulty level at any point in the game from the main menu.
[*] Introduced auto slotting of newly found items in empty quickslots.
[/list]

[h3]UPDATED:[/h3]
[list]
[*] More combat improvements - now it's as fluent as ever!
[*] Many GUI improvements
[*] Optimalisation improvements.
[*] DLSS had been updated to ver. 3.5 and FSR to ver. 2.2.
[*] Added various new sounds.
[*] Improved sorting of weapons and items in the inventory.
[*] Many game balance improvements.
[/list]

[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved attacking of sitting enemies.
[*] Song of Luck and Magnificent Song of Luck now increase the drop chance correctly.
[*] Fixed a bug where player would receive some XP from Skeletons summoned by Skeleton King after player's reviving in the Shrine.
[*] Dozens of collision fixes through all maps.
[*] Dozens of AI navigation fixes through all maps.
[*] Dozens of minimap fixes through all maps.
[*] Dozens of objects flickering fixes through all maps.
[*] Corrected display of logos on splashscreen in ratios 4:3 and 5:4.
[*] Patch notes can now be scrolled with controller.
[*] And many other minor fixes...

notes.title: The Story Rewritten (DevLog #6)
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Warriors![/h2]

It’s been a while since we last communicated how the production is going. We thought it’s high time we update you on our progress. A lot has changed on our side and we’d like you to take a quick sneak peek behind the scenes to see what’s coming.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/0f393880a36519f12342d8c5d95ad527340e1789.png[/img]

First off, here is the most exciting news: the Main Campaign of the game is getting a total makeover! If you have played the whole game already, you are still in for a treat - the story is brand new, and although Achilles is still in the center of it, there will be many surprises and a whole different feel to the game. Starting from the first moments in Troy…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/1b661e6477993a080ef83e4c027e50c9a1570362.png[/img]

The story will focus on Achilles, the great soldier and a renowned warrior at the peak of his life. Then… Our hero dies during the fight with Paris, as written in Homer’s Iliad.
Wait, he dies?
Now what?
It isn’t the end of him though, as he wakes up back in Greece without any memory of what has happened after his demise. Why is he still here? What has transpired in Troy? And why are there monsters and undead walking around? The mystery awaits to be unraveled. The main storyline is a bit tricky - we don’t want to give you any spoilers besides the dying part, so we won’t share much more about it. Again, even if you have played already - the story is not what it was before…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/ac291013068c60530325a91ef533c16f7fcc5993.png[/img]

During the Main Campaign, you’ll find a lot more NPCs. There’s more dialogue and a few additional in-game cutscenes. Achilles will also start to comment a lot more, sharing his thoughts and insights on the things he encounters. This will make the game more immersive for the player, as you’ll get to know our hero a bit better.
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/74bbe303cabce6a467255471d594f408edb107b0.png[/img]

Now, to get a bit technical: designing a story for a video game is a difficult task to take on. There’s a magnitude of things you have to consider if you want it to work well. For example, Action RPGs tend to focus more on gameplay mechanics, character progression, and combat systems. It can be challenging to strike the right balance between engaging gameplay and a compelling narrative. To keep one from overtaking the other, you have to place the story events very carefully, or risk overwhelming and distracting the player. The story needs to serve the gameplay first, taking the player throughout the vast world and for example not leave the whole areas empty and irrelevant, while giving the opportunity to explore freely.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/0b661795f5af50c7619bf37dfd84db67ca6b4dd4.png[/img]

The word of the day is: pacing. Balancing the story's pacing with gameplay progression and ensuring a steady flow of narrative moments while allowing for exploration and character development can be quite demanding. Before the current story changes, Achilles: Legends Untold also had a few “hiccups”. Did you know one of the cutscenes lasted about 7 minutes total? And without the “skip” option at first… Not every player is necessarily invested in the story at all, and we have to account for that. We’ve paid a lot of attention to aspects like these while redesigning the game’s storyline and thanks to that it’s now becoming more coherent and better paced than ever.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/8aa7fffcdfb4c1431eef9d89261494e67066bac8.png[/img]

The Troy section of the game now has a whole different feel to it. Instead of attacking the city by day, Achilles and his Myrmidons take on its defenses by nightfall. The map is a lot darker, although it’s lightened up by the flames of the ongoing siege. It’s giving off a more serious energy than before, with our hero determined to end the Trojan War right then and there. He searches for a way in for him and his soldiers while taking on whoever stands in his way, including some Trojan royalty…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/3abaa72afa51a3149d8766f8db0344e56224df9a.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/8c6ef23704be15b408f15ce505f19de178df5973.png[/img]

Beside the main story, some mechanics are also being tweaked. For starters, we’ve created an entirely new currency system - now you can collect XP and money for the shop separately! The XP increases the character level, and with each level you get a skillpoint to spend inside the skill tree. There’s also some smaller stuff we’re changing, like lowering the cost of the famous kick ability. Additionally, we’re constantly expanding the world with new locations and enemies, adjusting the combat system, fixing bugs and working on improving the game’s performance.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/64d68f6b4d2f096e6b5a760d42471fd0bdfef9d5.png[/img]

Some of you may have noticed something strange going on in the game’s library page. Achievements are being implemented! They are going to be available on every platform, all in due time. Some of them will be simple tasks, but others will prove to be more challenging to complete. We’re positive that the Achievement Hunters in the community will be pleased.

NOTE: some of the achievements will be unlockable only for the full release, so don’t worry if you haven’t collected them all in one go.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/183b0df8772fed27ebcd8534ae5fe577f955d820.png[/img]

We’re thrilled with all the feedback and support we got so far, and hope that it will continue in the future. We’re marching on and can’t wait to show you the effects of our team’s efforts. 

See you soon!

notes.title: The Spider Cave Update out now!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome warriors![/h1]

It's now been about a year since the game was first released. We've made a lot of progress during that time and a big part of it is thanks to our players. Your commitment and feedback has allowed us to bring the game to new levels of quality, and we hope that it will continue to do so up until the full release, later this year.

And as we celebrate the game's anniversary in Early Access, we present you with The [b]Spider Cave Update[/b], introducing swarms of new features.

Before we dive in, we want to share a [b]short trailer[/b] with you. Head on over to the link below to take a look at the epic new content!

[previewyoutube=2YeplVuBn34;full][/previewyoutube]
Now that you’re familiar with the additions, let’s go over the highlights in more detail.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/a492581a205dfcd22949eeb1750c69c333350d5b.png[/img]

This update introduces a brand new location on the game’s map - the titular [b]Spider Cave[/b]. Venture into the dark unknown, exploring each and every crevice while searching for untold loot in spider nests. New materials? Useful items? [i]Certain death?[/i] Who knows what you might find here…

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/061d2371bf794e549dfda62e49158c8ab221e28a.png[/img]
[i](WARNING: the Spiders don’t take too kindly to visitors.)[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/29cbe5d903339d421f58db1e0f220f7cc0f692eb.png[/img]

This is a feature that has been often requested by our players, so we got to work. This is the result: a brand new [b]Save Slot system[/b], complete with [b]3 separate slots[/b] for [b]3 separate simultaneous playthroughs[/b] of [i]Achilles: Legends Untold[/i]. Each slot shows the location where you left off, game difficulty, your character’s level, and the day you last played.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/f9fe8c8d2647a846fad1fbe4ea70d833b4b500fb.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/8ce9a53c17e03d1203261d857130f337f9c0a453.png[/img]

Rather than using venom like their green counterparts, these Spiders prefer burning their prey with a gust of fire. Better bring some marshmallows!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/a9a5dce2b37609925dfad9112080e5b2012fdf56.gif[/img]

The floral cast of the game has also been expanded. Biggest of all plants, this deadly creature spits explosive seeds, and could probably swallow Achilles in one bite. Keep your distance or become a bag of fertilizer!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/20682bab899374c2edfa29238022a81e89c727bb.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/e976da0091c8e75d67daf0f2f8c13eb290912252.png[/img]

Another useful new menu feature is the [b]Tutorials Tab[/b], accessible from the inventory menu. In this section, you can [b]revisit every tutorial screen[/b] you’ve seen so far, thereby making it the [i]Complete “Achilles: Legends Untold” Basic Movement And Essential Mechanics Knowledge Base™[/i].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/237a7e622e902390d94581b95daf3847463aa499.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/309bde6e66a0ff9f849972d26870f422da9fd602.png[/img]

Here’s a full list of changes made in [i]version 0.4.0[/i] of [i]Achilles: Legends Untold[/i], a.k.a. [b]“The Spider Cave Update”[/b]:

[h3]NEW:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a [b]new Cave map[/b] to explore [i](and perish while fighting spiders)[/i].
[*] Added [b]2 new enemies[/b] - a bigger, stronger plant variant and fire spiders.
[*] Introduced [b]save slots[/b] - now you’re able to lead 3 separate playthroughs!
[*] Introduced a [b]game tutorials tab[/b], accessible from the inventory menu.
[*] Added [b]2 new GAIA (Group AI Action) actions[/b] to make Heretic enemies [i]even more deadly[/i].
[*] Introduced [b]controller vibrations[/b].
[*] Added [b]deers[/b] running around in some locations.
[*] Introduced new options: [b]Gamma Correction[/b] & [b]Anti-Aliasing Method Selection[/b].
[/list]
[h3]UPDATED:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New and improved [b]head and face for Achilles[/b] - that’s right, Achilles has a new look! Enjoy!
[*] Improved the [b]dismemberment system[/b], so you can dominate enemies even more.
[*] Many combat improvements, like the [b]ability to interrupt blows[/b] [i](animation canceling)[/i] or a [b]better axe experience[/b].
[*] Some [b]balance improvements[/b], especially considering [b]status effects[/b]. For example, it’s now harder to extinguish the flames on a player.
[*] Some [b]clarity improvements[/b], like additional descriptions in shrines.
[*] Some [b]items and status effects[/b] icon improvements.
[/list]

[h3]FIXES:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slight overall game [b]performance improvement[/b].
[*] Pressing the sprint button no longer prevents the player from hitting enemies during combos.
[*] Camera now cannot move far away while changing the map.
[*] The player can now be hit by Agamenmon’s special skills even when he’s standing higher.
[*] Fire FX no longer appears above the ground.
[*] Weapon upgrades increase weapon damage instantly, so there is no need to wait for the game to be reloaded.
[*] Collisions on attacks have been improved, it should no longer happen that a blow does not hit even though the opponent was in range.
[*] Target lock has been fixed for sprint attacks.
[*] Many other minor bugs.
[/list]
[h3]NOTICE[/h3]
We would like to update our players on the current status of our game's co-op feature. At the moment, there are issues with accessing it through the random session search. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused, and our team is working to get this issue resolved by the next update. In the meantime, users can still access the co-op feature through direct invites or by joining from a friend's list.

That’s all for this post. Remember that you can share your feedback with us either through the [b]discussions tab[/b] in our [b]Steam Community Hub[/b] or by visiting our [b]Discord server![/b]

Thank you for all of your support so far, and see you next time!

notes.title: New Roadmap & Console Release Info
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Warriors![/h2]

We have some important news to share with you. Achilles: Legends Untold, our action RPG set in ancient Greece, will debut on [b]all major platforms simultaneously[/b].

We have been hard at work preparing for the game’s release [b]on next-gen consoles[/b] as well as [b]PS4 and Xbox One[/b]. With the goal of providing equal access to all players and ensuring that everyone can experience the new features and content, [b]we have decided to postpone the full PC version of the game to Q3 2023[/b], together with the console release. It will also allow us to polish all the content we plan to add, and it is a gargantuan task indeed - given how much we have in store!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/bf6045616ef2924ad0f278b697b79eb9c4224404.png[/img]

Below, you'll find a brand new roadmap for Achilles: Legends Untold. On it, you can see our plans for the next few months, up until the full release in Q3 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/c2e6167ba53c3c306454e41ce87d0805e160b93b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/20e2734d012babba0866e7743ed4db1a82a6b0cb.png[/img]

Given how in the past we added some features earlier than planned, we don’t want to give too much details right now, only general planned goals. We plan to release [b]at least two major updates[/b] before the full version of the game is launched, which will include [b]many new features[/b]. The nearest update to the game is coming in the [b]next month[/b]! We shall give you more details right before its premiere.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/9098bbba00794cddf0b9752da9504780b259633a.png[/img]

Somewhere in summer will come [b]the biggest story update yet[/b] -  with a [b]revisioned plot[/b], [b]new prologue in Troy[/b] and more features. The upcoming changes will require a reset of the saves, but thankfully it will be the last one (we’re about 99% sure). To sweeten the deal, we again shall provide the conversion of souls gathered previously, allowing you to keep the progress of your character.

Once the full release comes in full swing you will be able to enjoy [b]new locations, bosses and minibosses, enemies, Steam achievements, an improved character development system, new & updated GAIA actions[/b] and [i]many other items[/i]. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/158c585bea449e073eddf9d49635d14f0a832a23.png[/img]

We’d also like to address the elephant in the room, which is: the [b]co-op[/b] mode. We’re working on it! Our programmers wrestled with many different versions of it, testing which configuration is doable and satisfactory. We’ll reach the conclusion soon, and we can assure you there will be the co-op mode available in some form.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/3ad056c3bd9a70a42fba12a3a1e4f0ef6ba27ec6.png[/img]

Until the game’s full release, you can expect regular updates that improve gameplay, including a refined combat system, controls, performance, stability, and game balance.

[list]
[*] [b]Quality combat system[/b] - an improved combat system provides smooth and dynamic gameplay, increasing realism and fun.
[*] [b]Controls[/b] - game control updates provide faster response and precision, resulting in smoother gameplay and better user experiences.
[*] [b]Performance[/b] - game performance improvements enhance the framerate and smoothness of the game, allowing players to enjoy uninterrupted high-quality gameplay.
[*] [b]Stability[/b] - thanks to continuous stability updates the game works more reliably, fixing bugs and crashes
[*] [b]Balance[/b] - regular game balance updates ensure that the game is well balanced, meaning that no character type is too strong or too weak, contributing to even better gameplay.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/bb0ffbb9bd67ed3713f416f87d8c64caac25d012.png[/img]

With the release postponed, our players gain more time to enjoy the early access phase, allowing them to [b]have a real impact[/b] on the game’s development. We will continue to listen to [b]your feedback[/b] to better tailor the game to [b]your needs and expectations[/b].

Thank you for your patience and understanding. We are excited to deliver the best possible gaming experience to all of our players!

notes.title: Big Update 0.3.0
notes.content:
[h2]Hi everyone![/h2]

Today is the day - [b]we’ve just released the 0.3.0 Update![/b]

[b]It’s our biggest update yet! If you haven’t seen the trailer for it, go and check it out now using the link below:[/b]
https://youtu.be/Gn4LwfC8l94
Now that you’re back, we’re going to take a closer look at the new features. We have a lot of exciting content to go over, so let’s begin!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/fe2a760833566982b8e07a5268c54d2494b3711f.png[/img]

Our original GAIA system got not only improved, but extended too![b] We’ve added a lot of new ways for the enemies to cooperate with each other and attack in surprising ways. [/b]
As a reminder - GAIA allows the AI to evaluate the situation dynamically and decide to take action by itself, so it can launch anywhere at any time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/10f2aacff98fc0bf0570492f912c02ece2b3a2cb.gif[/img]

New GAIA actions include Cyclops throwing explosive barrels (or even other enemies) at you, feasting on people to heal themselves, skeletons molding into one big enemy and more.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/f32fa285f5c5933bd0435895dff363eeffef8961.png[/img]

Update 0.3.0 introduces [b]a lot of new enemies. [/b]While playing, you’ll encounter giant spiders slashing their claws, deadly plants spitting poison, mighty statues trying to crush you, and more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/7ab7df368e0a96fa87518e2c2b548f95be3a966b.gif[/img]

Test your skill against these various new opponents and come out victorious! (or not…)


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/c01355e23e1372ae8433b35161bbeef53d4ccd96.png[/img]

The game now has [b]a brand new crafting system! [/b]Collect ingredients while exploring the world of Ancient Greece, and combine them into new items on the go, using previously found crafting recipes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/072851fe7545e4d7b56b9eb810872685b107445f.png[/img]

Make new grenades, weapon reinforcements or resistance strengtheners whenever you need to!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/11c36ed25bcb1525ec84d5363a9f4060989d0c44.png[/img]

We’ve decided to liven up our map a bit. [b]It’s now full of destructible wooden barrels, crates, vases, and other objects that you can smash right through.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/2c9f4472f21845df312aab15a28033e0d12197ec.gif[/img]

Some of these can drop items, so pick up your weapon of choice and get every last one of them!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/d26c7a94970a22003781f25fd3f6c5be21cc8460.png[/img]

You now have a lot more freedom in the keybinding department.[b] Keyboard and mouse players can now bind up to two keys to one option, allowing the hold & click functionality.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/333461ce1288393baf3f8a8fc6678e782c073d2c.gif[/img]

Gamepad players also get more choices in how they play now.[b] We’ve added 2 new default control schemes and a 3rd one that’s customizable.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/240ce9cf0f44299e8cb6644ee03059d9c790c1b2.gif[/img]

These additions will allow everyone to control Achilles exactly how they want to.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/1a7cabf2da8d5a4c7240943c888b9ee4ebcaafa3.png[/img]

Apart from the usual performance improvements, Update 0.3.0 introduces two new optional technologies - [b]AMD FSR 2 and NVIDIA DLSS [/b]- that you can turn on in the settings.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/074e81bf4bd2536f654810e76530d6d43e73869b.gif[/img]

They both visibly increase the game’s framerate, making Achilles: Legends Untold run as smooth as ever!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/9f36871712325b0684670d1bd5ce5e0d7b5914b1.png[/img]

As we were saying for a while now, with this update the saves are going to be reset. You can either stay on the previous version of the game (0.2.0) by choosing a different branch in the Steam settings (see more here), or continue to the new and updated content.

We have good news! We’ve managed to put together a system that converts your character level from your old save and gives you the appropriate amount of souls after you finish the tutorial. We hope it will make the transition easier for you, and gives you even more motivation to explore this new update.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/309bde6e66a0ff9f849972d26870f422da9fd602.png[/img]

[b]NEW:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added destructible objects - destroy them to find some resources.
[*] Added the crafting system - collect and use resources to create items you need on the run.
[*] Added new throwable items - introduced darts and mines, along with an update of grenades.
[*] Added new enemies - test your skill against ginormous spiders, deadly plants, mighty statues,  and mysterious Laestrygonians!
[*] Added two new Dungeons, ready for exploration.
[*] Added new GAIA (Group AI Actions) and improved the existing ones. Watch out for them!
[*] Introduced remapping of gamepad controls, along with 2 ready-to-use presets.
[*] Introduced FSR and DLSS technologies support.
[*] Added new skill tree elements to unlock.
[*] Introduced the possibility of multiple item usage. No more going through Fate items one by one!
[*] Many other minor features and improvements...
[/list]
[b]UPDATED:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved teleportation with map usage - the map will now center on the selected Shrine for better orientation.
[*] Many minor improvements of the combat system, forming a much better and smoother experience together.
[*] A big update for all of the Basements/Cellars - now they are almost brand-new!
[*] An update for the Shield Throw skill - now you can throw the shield by simply releasing the aim button.
[*] Some attacks obtainable in the skill tree are now available from the start (e.g. sprint attack).
[*] A major UI update and increase in clarity.
[*] A major overhaul of the lions' and the wolves' movement system.
[/list]
[b]FIXES:[/b]
[list]
[*] Lifted the 30 frames per second limit in coop challenge mode.
[*] Highly improved overall game performance.
[*] Improved gamepad support and experience.
[*] Fixed various places where Achilles could get stuck, leave the playable area or clip through objects.
[*] Interaction with one of the chests in Greece can no longer freeze the player.
[*] Chests no longer appear closed after reloading the game.
[*] Player can't lose his shield after throwing it at Cyclop.
[*] Player can no longer start talking with Lysander while he is in combat.
[*] Player can no longer prematurely see the chest near Menelaos, if he didn't do any quests before.
[*] Castor now doesn’t stop attacking the player when he is near the wall.
[*] Over 130 other bug fixes of lesser importance.
[/list]

notes.title: The 2022 overview and the 2023 roadmap
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

The year 2022 came to an end, and what a year it was! We've made some substantial progress over these past twelve months, both in the game's development and as a studio. We wanted to briefly go over what happened this year and what we're planning on in 2023 here in our creativity forge, known as the Dark Point Games studio.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/246acac79e0ad7f6fd50b699fe97b0dd5da5c480.png[/img]

First things first, the full release date of "Achilles: Legends Untold". If all goes well, it's planned for the second quarter of 2023!

We're planning one more big update until then, version 0.3.0 of the game, and then it's straight for the 1.0.

[b]Let us show you a roadmap of the goals we want to reach this year:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/d12e7df8a5f1202af4dfa262259ba2f167aa1a69.png[/img]

If you’re more curious about the details, take a look below:

[h3]Patch 0.3.0:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Performance upgrades
[*] Improved default control mapping, also including custom key binding on controllers and ready presets to choose from
[*] Combat upgrades with additions like rolling through enemies when overwhelmed
[*] Diverse new enemies, featuring spiders, living statues and murderous plants
[*] Group AI Action (GAIA) system refinements, making the non-scripted group/environmental attacks more frequent
[*] New dungeons to explore
[*] More NPCs in the game’s world
[*] Quest expansion, focusing on extending the Agamemnon questlines
[*] Loads of new basement layouts to venture down to
[/list] [b]Important note: because of many changes implemented in the 0.3.0 patch, we plan to erase the current saves, since they would be incompatible with the most recent version of the game. Fret not though - it will be possible to keep playing your old save. 
More info on how to do it will be posted soon.[/b]

[h3]Full Release:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Complete main campaign with new characters to meet and new locations to explore
[*] Crafting
[*] Destructible objects across the whole world
[*] New version of the Troy
[*] New open-world map, the second part of Greece
[*] New boss fights
[*] A new and improved co-op mode rendition based on fighting enemy waves in arenas
[*] More Group AI Action (GAIA) attacks
[*] New enemies
[*] Skill tree alteration
[*] Multiple save slots
[*] Achievements
[/list] [b]Once the full game is released, it will be ported to Xbox Series X/S and PlayStation 5 consoles somewhere in Q3. There are also plans to optimize it for Steam Deck.
[/b]
The game will also be later expanded with new free content for you to enjoy.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/a2b6d8cd068c81716cb108dee0f20938e408865a.png[/img]

With all of these new features, let us not forget about everything we've already done! "Achilles: Legends Untold" has visibly changed during the last year, be it the map locations or the amount of content, including various enemies, weapons and items.

[b]OLD and NEW[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/8448ba471269d2b5b7464bffa58abc3f32d9cc31.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/af96fc220e0b27024d35b0986dff972015ba9562.gif[/img]

The game’s release in Early Access in May 2022 gave us a great opportunity, specifically a chance to involve the people that we’re developing the game for (that’s you!) in our work. Player feedback is a greatly valued thing here at the Dark Point Games studio, because it helps us make something that everyone can enjoy.

Thanks to you, the game received some great additions, for example the in-game map, but also balance improvements (including the difficulty and shrine placement) and bug fixes based on your reports. 

[b]We’ve also realized that because of the isometric view, “Achilles: Legends Untold” might resemble some titles, like for example “Titan Quest”, so we want to make it clear - the game does not belong to the Hack and slash genre. It has slower combat and relies mainly on the stamina bar, which forces the player to act more thoughtfully and be careful with each move.[/b]

You’ve been a great help so far. We’ll continue to listen to you while we progress with the development of “Achilles: Legends Untold”.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/b62e151f49c1e9b206d63e97dcb83be2874d0f26.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/2b3d3d50164075082e826e55255fe5cdcde06e6a.png[/img]

Not only did the game expand, but so did our team! In the beginning, only 4 people were working on the game, and now there are 20 of us! We're still a modest indie studio, but we're steadily gaining momentum and growing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/ecf895c170d533f1fed2805e2fec63f73ce3ca0b.png[/img]

This was also the first season in which we, as Dark Point Games, were able to present our game at a fair. What an experience it was for us! "Achilles: Legends Untold" was shown at some of the biggest European fairs – Gamescom, EGX London, Poznań Game Arena and Paris Games Week. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/def47afacaeef5b253267b780968349bc622bad3.png[/img]

It was amazing to meet all these people and feel the atmosphere of common passion between everyone we've talked to. We're already looking forward to more opportunities to see you, our players, and show you all what exciting new features we're working on now.

[b]We feel that “Achilles: Legends Untold” is really becoming the aRPG game we wanted to make, with the strategic, thoughtful real-time combat giving it a unique feel.[/b]

See you next time!

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/753044daac7a87231efa7fda454476c2a8c06513.png[/img]

[b]Hi everyone![/b]

A while has passed since our last DevLog, and the time is due for a new entry. Buckle up, we have some things to go over!

We're working hard at developing existing and new mechanics, fixing issues and testing out upcoming things. There's much, much more to show you regarding this process. This time however we have a few ready elements to showcase, here they are!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/c255a429f7c9b05bc38842659789e9317611267c.png[/img]

The quest focused around finding Agamemnon will get expanded! Agamemnon is a king, and each king worthy of his title has a palace that he rules his kingdom from. Agamemnon’s is located right in Mycenae, where you’ll be able to see it in all of its might.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/df05e54420b1e5122c926c5f0d18ffc196ab703e.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/9af3a02600f7197b54b7058b3ba0198b60b227dc.png[/img]

[b]Using many items at once[/b] - a feature much requested by our players - will be available in the next update! Now you won’t have to get through all the fate items you’ve collected one by one. We hope it will provide you with a new level of convenience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/f00a0163c5e045394f7aa34a40f125e643603c37.gif[/img]

We’re also adding a simple [b]crafting mechanic[/b] - you’ll be able to make some items straight out of your inventory!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/26ecb91653ea0ba40bfd0783ec23122521e691a9.gif[/img]

There is much more to come. Stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/4e2e2dff07bdc95a67a673470c8a89a6c789ccd5.png[/img]

[h3]Did you know?[/h3]

[i]Agamemnon, the king of Mycenae and the brother of Menelaus, was the one who commanded the Greeks during the Trojan War.

In Homer’s Iliad, near the end of the war he had a quarrel with Achilles. He stole an attractive slave called Briseis, one of the spoils of war, from Achilles. This created a rift between Achilles and Agamemnon, causing Achilles to withdraw from battle and refuse to fight.

Agamemnon, having realized Achilles's importance in winning the war against the Trojan Army, sent ambassadors begging for Achilles to return, offering him riches and the hand of his daughter in marriage. Achilles refused, only being spurred back into action when Patroclus was killed in battle by Hector, eldest son of King Priam and Queen Hecuba.[/i]

notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone!  [/b]

The time has come - today's the day [b]we release Update 0.2.0 into the wild! [/b]We've been sharing details about its new features for some time now, and finally you can experience everything for yourself.

Let’s begin with a video showcase of what this update has to offer:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KnPDsqVMgzc

The main features introduced in version 0.2.0 include a minimap, two new bosses, a new Tartarus Rifts side activity, new dungeon locations, and more.

[b]Below is a full list of changes made to Achilles: Legend Untold in Update 0.2.0:[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/56105c8212090a8bb4e2c344cc5da946c2666283.png[/img]
[list]
[*] [b]Minimap and Map[/b] ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1314000/view/3222909306854312976]read "DevLog #2 for more[/url])

[list]

[*] Updated collisions

As you can see, it's quite a packed release! We're excited to let you see all the new content we've prepared over these few months and get your feedback on it. We really value our players, so if you have any thoughts you want us to hear, make sure to share them! 

If you find out that any bugs slipped through, please report them to us either through our Discord server at the [i]#bug-reports channel,[/i] or the Steam Discussions forum. We'll make sure to go through them and squash as many of them as we can.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/745633542bb939674528b828d40c6db3371227ed.png[/img]

If you're wondering what's next for Achilles: Legends Untold, we've prepared a brand new roadmap with teasers of features coming to the game. We'll be sharing more details over the course of their development, so keep an eye out for new DevLogs in the future! 

[b]That's everything for now. Have fun and enjoy the update! [/b]

notes.title: A Look at Pollux - The Divine Son of Zeus (Devlog #3)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! There are still some features coming in 0.2.0 that we haven’t revealed yet. No time like the present, right? Let’s get right to it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/e8dc9f32c6cbdd8a31ad7f7ee1dab969ef845502.png[/img]

Brother to Castor, one of the Dioscuri, and a champion of Zeus - [b]Pollux[/b] is the second boss coming to the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/559c9caa8f3f06c5d3b0164b353ebeff6e9b397f.jpg[/img]

He's equipped with a sword, a beautifully ornamented shield, and solid armor that protects him from enemy attacks.

Pollux's godly heritage gives him a bit of an advantage in combat, as he possesses some [i]powerful abilities:[/i]
[list]
[*] Opposite to Castor's defensive field, Pollux creates [b]an area of sunlight[/b] so strong that it [b]deals damage[/b] to Achilles, but barely weakens himself.
[*] Pollux can [b]teleport[/b] to Achilles in a relentless attack. You might never see it coming, before it’s too late...
[*] Pollux can [b]leap forward[/b] at Achilles from a great distance, extending his attack's reach and leaving significant wounds on target struck. 
[/list]
You can see a quick showcase of them below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/257470acff43397d347270c71c12422e39c9f764.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/188dd95499eec2f0391a955a7414c75ee2598dcb.png[/img]

Remember those mysterious gates we showed in the last devlog? It’s time for a reveal - they actually lead to [b]entire new locations![/b]  After you go through one of these passageways, you'll find [i]a whole new dungeon[/i] to explore.

It won't be easy though - some of them are full of undead, others are filled with bandits; you might even have mythical creatures standing in your way!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/13a70e6079784a21205acc775f59652d0ed1beac.png[/img]

At the end of each dungeon, there's [b]a chest with rewards[/b], and [b]an exit portal,[/b] so you don't have to go all the way back where you came from.

Can you complete them all?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/963f30f790f5aed55016e7f7765e737943931b19.png[/img]

We’ve already shown you what in-game minimap’s current version looks like, but there’s also an entire [b]fullscreen map[/b] for you to use! It’s the first iteration and it will certainly undergo changes down the road, but it’s already pretty useful right now.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/0253be4c3724ec4c9b57111f774f6e212277e76a.gif[/img]

You can scroll around the entire world map and either seek various points of interest like shrines and chests, or look for locations you haven’t visited yet. The map [b]gradually reveals itself[/b] as you explore the world of Achilles: Legends Untold. Try to discover it all!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/a280cf7884f08013d8b1c7140b15238cd9478b82.png[/img]

Our loading screens now contain [b]tips for the game[/b]! They should make the short wait in between levels more enjoyable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/f15e5e233b891ae8bc0ae6bebb4b078b3baf8370.jpg[/img]

We’re getting really close to the update’s release! Our hopes are up, and we think you’ll really enjoy the new content we have prepared.

[h3]Until next time![/h3]

notes.title: The Coming of Tydeus (DevLog #2)
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

First off, as the dust after Gamescom has settled, we have a few words we want to say to you:

[previewyoutube=3sX8ynkYSnU;full][/previewyoutube]

There’s a lot of exciting stuff we want to share, so with that out of the way, let’s get right into the next DevLog!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/70b8efbc6f70836d1866a75d67f7dc2ce8a6b49a.png[/img]

The feature that’s been the most requested one for some time now - [b]the in-game minimap[/b] - is in the late polishing stage! It tracks Achilles’ position, and shows you the shortest path to the currently followed quest objective. Navigating ancient Greece has never been easier! Now you can be sure [b]you won’t miss anything[/b].

As promised in the last post, [b]a quick showcase[/b] of it in action:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/564759f09053cbec6dd09db264d80360c5a7f137.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/ff649e7e910ac64744888c0d1e2b4c075a378631.png[/img]

Remember the mad, [i]brain-eating[/i] warrior we showed you in the last entry? Well, he’s gotten a lot more polished since then! Our 3d artist has been working hard on his model, and it really paid off! You can see the effects in the shots below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/2a188a8db6426041cea89225d9c98280f1b174c9.png[/img]

We’ve also given a lot of care to the boss fight itself - Tydeus is [b]a warrior to behold[/b]!

First off, he has mastered the [b]art of the dual blade[/b] - his attacks are fast, and his aggressive tendencies only fuel his strength. The swords he’s wielding are so sharp, that they can [b]inflict heavy bleeding[/b], if he manages to even slightly cut you with his attacks.

Tydeus has a number of impressive skills, including:
[list]
[*] [b]A powerful swing of his sword[/b] -  [b]extended in range[/b], as if his burning hatred imbued the blade, lengthening its reach.
[*] [b]A spinning dash attack[/b] - don’t blink or you’ll miss it! Tydeus [b]leaps forward, twirling his swords at high speed[/b] and slashing everything in his path.
[*] [b]A jump attack[/b] - Tydeus springs upwards, and uses all of his momentum to deal death from above to his enemies.
[*] [b]Sword throw[/b] - what to do, when your enemy keeps getting out of your attack range? [b]Extend it.[/b] Tydeus [b]throws spinning swords[/b] at you, creating a flying blade vortex.
[/list]

You can see that madman performing each of the moves mentioned before in this GIF below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/6867c7806bdc66307337de18ed27323840383ad8.gif[/img]

As a little secret, [b]he's not the only boss making an appearance[/b] in the upcoming update. There is one more, although [i]we won’t reveal who he is just yet…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/961a4209212d12c04fef68cc3f6650dad6fb01bc.png[/img]

The arenas are now [b]fully functional[/b] and in the polishing stage!

There will be several [b]rift entrances[/b] scattered around the world - they’re the manifestation of Tartarus intertwining with the mortal plane. Your objective here, is to [b]rid them of all the enemies[/b] trying to breach through, and then [b]close the entrances[/b]. That way you can restore some balance and bring back order to the human world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/55a1bfd65951245f5a06012fdbffd37ec170c2cf.png[/img]

Each rift is [b]a series of various combat waves[/b]. All of the enemies you’ll find here are [b]tainted with underworld’s energy[/b], making them [b]stronger[/b] (and more ominous looking) than their regular counterparts, which you might have already met.

You can watch one of the arenas getting beaten and the rift closed in this preview clip:

[previewyoutube=YQh9jZKmr2A;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/008b1fdd843a645bb31af503750238d446c3c538.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/b22a1286d49b607ea81cf17c81e6d9b3de47e5fe.png[/img]

Some [b]mysterious doors[/b] have appeared around map. Where do they lead to? Guess we’ll have to [i]wait and see…[/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/784c6db195760dd078cc589e82dfd2de72c3ab9c.png[/img]

As we already mentioned before, [b]we’ve been to Gamescom this year![/b] Our visitors got to try early some of the features from above. It was an amazing opportunity for us to hear firsthand what people have to say. We not only loved getting to show them what we’ve been working on, but also really enjoyed just talking to the players, [i]like gamers to gamers[/i].

Let’s get back to the game though - [b]there was a lot of progress made[/b] lately, and we’re getting closer and closer to releasing the update. There’s some polishing left to do, we want our players to enjoy the new content without any troubles, and that’s exactly what we’re aiming for right now.

From the smaller changes, grenades got [b]trajectory prediction[/b]! If you hold down the quick use button, you can [b]aim your throw and see its AoE[/b] on screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/2a7c35004402761c82d4c761f1f84c3176b05c60.gif[/img]

Character rotation also got smoothed out a bit. As always, we’re keeping track of the optimization and increasing it where we can. 

That’s it for today. Overall, it’s all looking pretty good! We can’t wait to let everyone try it already.

[i]See you next time![/i]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/fca35466c23e53b9c9a8fd717a3440241673175a.png[/img]

[h3][i][b]Did you know?[/b][/i][/h3]
[i]Tartarus is a place dedicated to the imprisonment and torment of mortals, who had sinned against the gods. Each punishment was unique to the condemned.

Some of the inhabitants of Tartarus are Cyclopes, Kronos, some Titans like Prometheus, King Sisyphus, King Tantalus, Ixion, Danaides, giant Tityos, and King Salmoneus.

According to Hesiod, a bronze anvil falling from heaven would fall for nine days, before it reaches the earth. That same anvil would take nine more days to fall from earth to Tartarus.[/i]

notes.title: The Road to Update 0.2.0 (Devlog #1)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! 

Recently, we have been sharing some insights about the development of Achilles: Legends Untold. The posts were pretty well received, so we decided to [b]officially make them into a regular thing[/b]! This is the first entry in a new series of [b]Devlogs[/b], that will show you some of the features we’re working on, as well as behind-the-scenes stuff happening at our studio. Let’s begin, shall we?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/70b8efbc6f70836d1866a75d67f7dc2ce8a6b49a.png[/img]

We’ve been working on a big content update for some time now. 

One of the main and [b]most requested features[/b] that will be making an appearance, is the [b]in-game map.[/b] Well, we think you’ll be happy to hear that the hardest part is already behind us, and the [b]basics are already in place![/b] 

The map in Achilles: Legends Untold will consist of a [b]minimap on the HUD[/b], and a bigger, [b]fullscreen[/b] one, that you can scroll around to seek various points of interest. 

Of course, it still needs improvements, but seeing it in a working state made us all even more motivated to work. We're still working on the visual design of the map, but we’ll have something nice to show you soon ;).

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/961a4209212d12c04fef68cc3f6650dad6fb01bc.png[/img]

Another thing that’s in development right now, are the [b]fight arenas[/b]. 

It’s a [b]new activity[/b] for Achilles to take on – the player will be able to enter a new level, where he will face a sequence of [b]special enemy waves.[/b]

We grabbed a short gif of the place, to showcase where you’ll be fighting. Take a look!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/f7fa2edbb8f5277058dc05302b04edef93732cc7.gif[/img]

The Arenas are all [b]Hades-themed[/b], with a slightly spooky vibe to them. You’ll get to fight unique, stronger enemy variants, tainted by the underworld’s energy.

[b]Each arena can be visited once,[/b] through an entrance point on the main map, that will close after you successfully complete the challenge.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/a00f43eb4fedf1cdfec37d266e078f31b8be0b49.png[/img]

[h3]Tydeus[/h3]
The next feature we want to talk about is our newest [b]boss fight[/b]. The enemy in question is the mighty [b]Tydeus[/b], known mostly from the story of the Seven Against Thebes, who fought to take back the Thebes for Polynices. 

The boss fight itself is still being polished, but if you’re curious how’s he going to look, here’s a [b]concept art[/b] straight from under the pen of one of our artists:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/5a49f6eabc2d75a9e24eeecd434b59ba2f6de072.jpg[/img]

[h3]Castor[/h3]
That’s not all! We’re also still [b]expanding on our current bosses[/b]. Castor just got [b]more skills[/b] to aid him in defending his village. He’s a master in wielding his battleaxe - he’s able to perform a [b]powerful 2-hit combo[/b], swinging it at you, or rush at you from a distance. Be careful while fighting him, or you can easily get chopped in half.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/7cb2c29e216a5757596aee6a34cc51c12d991b00.gif[/img]

The boss also received a second move - he can [b]slam his shield against the ground[/b], summoning a [b]healing circle[/b] around him. His health will [b]slowly regenerate[/b] while he stands inside, so better try and kick him out of there!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/315a3395cf6de4ffaa7c284a70c6f1e10991c327.gif[/img]

Castor will now pose as a [b]greater challenge[/b] for heroes daring to cross the stone bridge, that the passage through he’s guarding so vigilantly.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/550bf851dc9c73f612f337432b8ca6906b24f1ea.png[/img]

We’re [b]livening up the map[/b] a bit! Now you’ll not only encounter warriors and various beasts scattered around Greece, but also [b]the villagers[/b] that live and work there. 

They’re not really the combative type – when they see a fight, they get scared, scream, and [b]run for their lives.[/b] See for yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/577451c03afc02d90ffb9872d8b8f5127e29f837.gif[/img]

Killing them is [b]completely optional[/b], and it [b]doesn’t grant any rewards[/b], so it’s up to you to decide what kind of warrior you’ll be.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/784c6db195760dd078cc589e82dfd2de72c3ab9c.png[/img]

Apart from working on the new features, we’re still honing our current ones. The AI will be getting a [b]new and improved player targeting system[/b] ([url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1314000/view/3338872734887053154]see our previous dev post for more details![/url]). Some items will be getting a bit of a rework, mostly [b]new icons and descriptions[/b]. We’re also smoothing out the controls, squashing the leftover bugs and increasing the overall optimization.

It’s all [b]hard work[/b] here at Dark Point Games! Our team’s morale is high, and we’re excited to let you play the update for yourself when it releases.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/fca35466c23e53b9c9a8fd717a3440241673175a.png[/img]

Achilles: Legends Untold’s setting is entirely based around [b]Greek Mythology[/b]. It’s full of interesting stories, and we’d love to share some of them with you! From here on out, the Devlogs will have a special [b]trivia section[/b] at the end - ranging from fun facts about our characters, through some lesser-known details about the events from the myths they partake in.

[h3][i]Did you know?[/i][/h3]
[i]Tydeus was mortally wounded by Melanippus during the war. Athena, the Goddess of Wisdom, intended to make him immortal, but the seer Amphiaraus cut off the head of Melanippus and gave it to Tydeus, who proceeded to eat the brains of his killer. The Goddess, revolted by what she saw, changed her mind and left Tydeus to die.[/i]

notes.title: AI Improvements and Additions
notes.content:
Hey everyone! We're back with another behind-the-scenes look into our development process. This week we're diving into how we're improving combat in the game by focusing on improvements to enemy AI.

Achilles: Legends Untold is an action game - one of its most important elements is [b]the combat system[/b]. And, as you know, combat is only as good as the enemies you fight! That’s why we give [b]special care to the enemy AI[/b] during development. We want the game to provide you with truly formidable opponents and memorable, challenging encounters. Here’s [b]an inside look[/b] on how we’re managing and continuing to improve our enemy AI:

[h2]The Old AI System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/ca1fb20c3b5abfddeb4c47d323c1999097b24b19.png[/img]

The original system we were using was based on [b]“attack tokens”[/b]. First, the game [b]checked the current condition[/b] of the fight - how much time has passed since the last attack? How many enemies are fighting Achilles right now? What type of enemies are they?

Then, the enemies, who were chosen after the condition check, were given some amount of attack tokens from the limited [b]total pool[/b]. They were able to consume these tokens by [b]attacking Achilles[/b] - then the AI [b]returned them[/b] to the pool, so they could be dispensed again, during the next condition check.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/82d94ae53778eeb50c8c8194fb728714cc6e6db3.gif[/img]
[i](Enemies attacking & instantly backing off)[/i]

That’s how the game chose who will be striking at our hero and when he should do it. We decided the system needed improvements. We’ve been getting feedback from our players, that the opponents back off too quickly after attacking, and that it’s hard to counterattack efficiently. We’re listening! - and that’s why [b]we’re making some changes[/b].

[h2]The New AI System[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/06a4a59d6c1eca7fd97013f1697922bc654e00a3.png[/img]

The new & improved system is similar, but it [b]splits enemies into certain groups[/b]. The AI can either be on the [b]passive[/b] or the [b]active[/b] list. What does this mean? 

[list][*] [b]Active[/b] - An enemy that gets on the active list will [b]stay close[/b] to Achilles and try to [b]attack[/b] him. 
[*] [b]Passive[/b] - On the other hand, the enemies on the [b]passive[/b] list will give way to the active ones - they will [b]move around at a distance[/b] and [b]taunt[/b] our hero, waiting for their turn.[/list]
What does that mean for the player? With these changes, the combat will feel [b]a lot more continuous[/b] - enemies that attack Achilles will [b]stay focused[/b] on him longer, giving the player a better [b]opportunity to punish them and counterattack[/b]. The fights will be much more natural, with enemies moving around more strategically. It will make the whole system feel [b]less clunky[/b], improving on the current AI behavior.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/0561988095525fd3e7f038bff1208d45d5142ea5.gif[/img]
[i](Improved token system, enemies stay more focused)[/i]

[h2]On the Offensive[/h2]

The combat style of our AI is shifting from a focus on defense to a more offensive-minded behavior. Now the enemies will be [b]more vulnerable[/b] to your counters, but they won’t just let you attack them so easily. They are becoming [b]more aggressive[/b] and will hunt you relentlessly! You will have to adapt your fighting style and strategy in order to survive against these more aggressive enemies . This fundamental change will make gameplay [b]feel more dynamic[/b] and keep you on your toes, as you maneuver your way through more challenging opponents.

[h2]New Enemy Abilities[/h2]

That’s not all! Apart from improving the AI system, we’re also actively [b]expanding[/b] upon it. We want our enemies to have [b]a wide array of attack types[/b] and environment interactions, so we’re constantly [b]experimenting and adding new ones[/b]. For example, here are two new abilities we’ve been working on:

[h3]The Spear Throw[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/ea51443c6182d033520a5dd30e3ee05bfc36fd8c.gif[/img]

See these spears in the ground, scattered around the map? Enemies are able to locate them, [b]pick them up, and throw them[/b] at Achilles using all their might and strength. If you don’t want to become a human shish kebab, watch out and [b]dodge them![/b]

[h3]The Flaming Arrows[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/5163fb14146eb15a89425b4dbfb468928c734279.gif[/img]

We have many fireplaces placed in all of Greece, and it’s time we put them to a better use! Apparently, the archers haven’t been taught not to play with fire - they are now able to come up to any fire source, and [b]light their arrows with flame[/b]. Better extinguish their enthusiasm, or you’ll get 3rd degree burns!

[h3]Bonus[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/a51bf85065b9983c3d18837bb6db628fd9186597.gif[/img]

We’re also creating [b]unique abilities[/b] for the bosses. As you might’ve already seen, in patch 0.1.3 we expanded on [b]Menelaus’ skillset[/b]. Now he’s carrying a bottle with a purple fluid - he can drink some of it and[b] spit at Achilles, poisoning him[/b]. He’s also able to [b]cover his weapon[/b] with it and start [b]dealing poison damage[/b] on hit.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40963701/bc9d71f06d51fca22f7c4cd9d6b00f27432c2a3b.gif[/img]

As it turns out, Menelaus is also a bit of a pyromaniac - he likes to [b]light his sword on fire[/b], burning Achilles with each strike. Using it, he can also [b]spit fire at you[/b]! A dangerous foe indeed.

We’re giving our all to the game’s combat. notes.title: Patch 0.1.3
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

In [b]Patch 0.1.3[/b] we added a highly requested [b]'Unstuck' button[/b] for those tricky times that Achilles clips into terrain and cannot get out. We've worked hard to fix this issue in all known areas, but on the rare instance it happens this feature will stop you from frustratingly losing progress. 

We've also added an option to [b]force return Achilles to the last Shrine[/b] rested at, at the cost of leaving all Souls behind. Effectively a [b]'Kill Achilles' option[/b]; use it carefully.

Many other known bugs have also been fixed in this patch, including: blocked quest progression, enemy/boss despawn issues, unreachable loot, and many others. 

[b]Below is a list of all the updates made to Achilles: Legends Untold in Patch 0.1.3.:[/b]

[h3][b]Added Features[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added [b]“Unstuck” button[/b]. Now, if Achilles gets stuck somewhere in terrain, you’ll be able to free yourself by using this feature from the pause menu.
[*] Added an option in the menu to force Achilles to [b]return to the last shrine[/b] he rested at, leaving your collected souls behind.
[*] [spoiler]Menelaus[/spoiler] was given new special abilities. 
[*] Inventory items are now [b]sorted into categories[/b].
[*] Added support for French AZERTY keyboards.
[/list]
[h3][b]Fixes and Improvement[/b]s[/h3]
[list]
[*] We’ve applied a temporary fix to the issue with animations in co-op mode being inconsistent when the client’s frame rate was different than the host’s. For technical reasons, we are temporarily limiting the framerate in co-op to 30 FPS, until we finish working on a solution.
[*] We’ve made multiple[b] improvements to the AI[/b], focusing mainly on pathing.
[*] [b]Fixed quest progression issues[/b]. Completing the Temple of Cronos before finding Hephaestus no longer prevents quest progression.
[*] Fixed an issue where Firtos quest could not be completed.
[*] Fixed an issue where co-op dungeon couldn’t be completed.
[*] [b]Fixed boss despawn bug[/b]. Skeleton King and other bosses will no longer despawn when quitting the game during a boss fight.
[*] Fixed a variety of visual bugs, including erratic enemy movements.
[*] [b]Fixed unreachable loot bug[/b], where loot from enemies could spawn out of Achilles’ reach.
[*] [b]Fixed all known clipping issue[/b]s. Every known spot where Achilles could get stuck or fall through the map has been fixed.
[*] [b]Fixed Window type selection bug[/b]. Fullscreen/Windowed selection will now save correctly.
[*] Fixed a crash that could appear in the equipment screen.
[*] Avast Antivirus will no longer return a false positive on scan.
[*] [b]Fixed all known localization errors.[/b]
[/list]
We thank everyone who has shared and reported bugs across the Discord, Steam forums, and social media! We see all of your reports and they really do help us improve the game experience.

notes.title: Known Issues and Player Feedback
notes.content:
Player feedback is incredibly important to us, and is a big reason why we brought the game to Early Access. Your feedback will help us make Achilles: Legends Untold the best it can be.

[h2]Co-op[/h2]
We are aware of the performance issues players are experiencing in our co-op game mode. The team is working hard to address and fix these issues as soon as possible. 

[h2]Known Issues[/h2]
Below is a list of other issues and bugs in the game that we are aware of so far. These are all actively being worked on.
[list]
[*] [strike][b]Despawning Skeleton King and other bosses[/b][/strike] - FIXED
Exiting the game during the Skeleton King boss fight can cause issues after reloading the game. Players will get back to the boss arena and despawn the Skeleton King, locking themselves into the arena. Other boss fights might have the same issue

[*][b][strike]Getting stuck in environment[/strike][/b] - FIXED
In some cases, players can get hard-stuck in some environments. In rare cases, players need to restart the game entirely, as only reloading the game may have Achilles still stuck  in the same position

[*][b][strike]Visual bugs when opening the equipment menu during portal travel[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Opening the equipment menu during portal travel may break the camera settings and cause the Achilles model to disappear from the equipment menu screen

[*][b][strike]Unable to interact with Shrines after potion teleport[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Using teleport to home potions during combat can cause problems with some interactive objects, mainly Hades Shrines. To fix it players will have to leave to the main menu and get back to the game.

[*][b][strike]Chiron's armor visual bug[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Wearing Chiron's Armor may distort Achilles' look in gameplay.

[*][b][strike]Firtos quest completion bug[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Dying during the fight with the three scorpions may cause an issue where one scorpion despawns, leaving the player unable to finish the quest.

[*][b][strike]King Scorpio completion bug[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Dying or leaving a fight with King Scorpio may cause him to de-spawn leaving the player unable to finish the quest.

[*][b][strike]Fullscreen/Windowed selection not saving[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Changing video settings to fullscreen or windowed fullscreen may not be saved in config file.

[*][b]Fall through world at Chronos' temple[/b]
On the wooden stairs close to Chronos’ temple it's possible for the player to sometimes fall through the world

[*][b][strike]Inconsistent co-op animation [/strike][/b] - FIXED
In co-op, low FPS on the host will cause jumpy animations on the client side.

[*][b]Teleporting to Mountain Forest issue[/b]
Interaction with the portal to Mountain Forest may cause game freeze

[*][b][strike]Equipment screen crash[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Opening the equipment menu at the exact time a tutorial message pops up may cause the game to freeze or crash

[*][b][strike]Cronos before Hephaestus blocking progression[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Entering Chronos’ temple before releasing Hephaestus can block progression in the main story line

[*][b][strike]Falling through world in the lower dungeon[/strike][/b] - All known FIXED
In some instances, entering the lower dungeon level can sometimes lead to falling through the world

[*][b][strike]Avast Antivirus false positive[/strike][/b] - No longer reported
Avast antivirus can report false positive virus detection. We have confirmation from Avast that Achilles is verified and should not cause this issue

[*][b][strike]Localization issues[/strike][/b] - All known FIXED
Players may encounter some localization issues in languages other than English – missing translations, some text boxes might be empty or have text from other languages

[*][b][strike]Co-op Dungeon completion bug[/strike][/b] - FIXED
In rare cases during co-op, players may encounter issues that make dungeon completion impossible

[*][b][strike]Collision with objects bug[/strike][/b] - All known FIXED
In Greece, there are rare occasions where the player may get stuck in objects or fall through the map. Exiting to the main menu and selecting ‘Continue’ should fix the problem

[*][b][strike]Erratic enemy AI[/strike][/b] - FIXED
Sometimes enemies may act erratic, or in rare cases stop fighting the player entirely

[*][b][strike]Unobtainable loot[/strike][/b] - FIXED
In rare cases, loot drops from enemies may spawn outside the playable area and be unobtainable by the player

[*][b]Completed quests shown as ongoing[/b]
Some completed quests may be displayed in the journal as ‘ongoing’
[/list]
We're working hard on fixing these bugs and we appreciate your patience. We will continue to be transparent with the community on what we are working on with the game throughout Early Access.

[b]We welcome feedback and other bug reports in our Discord, on our social accounts, and in the Steam forums.[/b] 

Thank you for your passion and support for Achilles: Legends Untold!

[h2]Launch day has arrived![/h2]
[previewyoutube=zuAebfwH-hU;full][/previewyoutube]
Hey everyone! We're so excited to finally launch Achilles: Legends Untold into Early Access! Our small team has worked hard to deliver on our vision of making a challenging, but rewarding Souls-like experience featuring the legendary warrior Achilles ⚔️.

[b][h3]Early Access[/h3][/b]
Early Access is just the beginning of our journey! We have a full campaign that we'll continue to add content to as we approach the full release of the game, and we'll be listening to all community feedback to help us shape Achilles: Legends Untold into the best game possible.

[b][h3]Roadmap[/h3][/b]
We'll reveal more of our plans for the game throughout Early Access, but here's what you can expect in the short term:
[list]
[*] [b]Twitch Integration[/b] - We want to help audiences engage with their favorite Twitch streamers during gameplay. We'll be adding the ability for viewers to vote on whether they REWARD or PUNISH streamers. It's up to the audience whether they choose kindness, or chaos.
[*] [b]Arenas[/b] - We'll be introducing portals to transport you from Greece to the depths of Tartarus. These challenging combat arenas will pit you against waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

notes.content:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

[h3]The Achilles: Legends Untold Beta is now open until [b]Monday, February 14th![/b][/h3]

If you are just discovering Achilles: Legends Untold for the first time, you can join the Beta by heading over to our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1314000/Achilles_Legends_Untold/]Steam page[/url] and [b]clicking 'Request Access'[/b] and then [b]'Play Now'[/b].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1314000/Achilles_Legends_Untold/][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/40963701/b48907c488ad22164059b942b14c1ccacfb67eb5.png[/img][/url]

[h1]PATCH NOTES[/h1]

[h2]ADDED FEATURES:[/h2]
* Holding sprint button when stamina gets to 0 will retrigger sprinting when stamina gets to 70%
* FX showing when Enraged skeletons will attack
* New Weapon Skills for Spear: THORNS

[h2]IMPROVEMENTS:[/h2]
* Final boss fight updated
* Added localisation: German, Spanish, Russian, French, Portuguese
* More fluid inventory entering and leaving
* Weapons Balance - speed, stamina usage, damage
* Hoplite Spear new animations for combo quick attacks, strong attacks
* Enemies - Souls, Drop rate update (also on NG+)
* Increased range from player to AI, at which AI hides weapon and runs back
* Increased range icons visibility on interactive objects
* Blocked interactive icons are visible during the fight
* Skeleton King behaviors
* Autolock distance increased
* Target Lock - auto lock next target when enemy die
* Stamina bar under a player character is enabled by default
* Minor Old Ruins location improvements

[h2]BUG FIXES:[/h2]
* NG+ system - enemy defense
* Aspect ratio in intro
* Scorpion and Medium Warriors aggro range
* Gamepad compatibility issue in Skill Tree
* Target Lock Optimization
* Localization improvements
* Fixed permanent text bug during Hector and Paris boss fights
* Skeletons summoned by Skeleton King now die properly
* Player stun tweaked
* Weapon Skill: ANGERED EARTH - dual wielding animation fix
* HP bar and last damage visibility
* Player's sprint attack only work when in motion
* Player's 100% block no longer doing chip damage
* Unintended dodge when leaving inventory or attacking while pressing sprint button
* Player character's animation stuck in a guard state sometimes
* AI behavior on returning to spawn point
* AI dodge
* Archer's freeze in NG+
* Skeleton King pushed out of his combat arena
* Invalid screen displays when switching between inventory screens too fast
* AI avoidance
* Sometimes players could trigger boss battle without passing a boss barrier
